actions.reason: Jab Headbutt: Moveset gives one 2% strike; both catalog IDs are 2%, angle 0 at 2-3. Repeated inputs are new jabs, not sweet/late variants.
Running Headbutt: source gives 8%; both catalog zones stay 8%, angle 361 at 5-16. No power-decay phase is present to justify a clean/late selection.
Forward tilt up: source explicitly gives 9% for selected angle; all three zones are 9% at 5-14. Up/level/down are input-selected actions, not an action-local sweetspot.
Forward tilt level: source gives 8%; all three zones are 8% at 5-14. Do not compare to the separate 9% up-angle action to create labels.
Forward tilt down: source gives 7%; all three zones are 7% at 5-14. Selected attack angle is not positional sweet/sour variation.

Up tilt: tail IDs 0/1 are 7%, angle 96; tip ID 2 is 6%, angle 88, all bone 47 at 7-14. Character names tail/tip but move Overview is empty and no source adjudicates sweet/sour. Higher damage is insufficient.
Tail Sweep: source gives 7%; three tail zones all retain 7%, angle 35 at 7-9. Geometry differences alone do not establish named sweet/sour roles.

Electric Flower: Moveset identifies six 2% trapping hits plus a 3% seventh hit. Catalog has six pulses at 7-8 through 22-23 and separate ID 0 finisher at 25. Finisher damage does not establish a sweetspot.

Rechecked sweetspot-labels.md Clean/late continuation independently: IDs 0/1/2 on bones 41/33/4 have clean 12% at 3-10 and late 9% at 11-28. All exact signatures match existing clean-spin/late-spin labels.
Electric Drill: source explicitly says four 2% hits; catalog pulses 10-12,14-16,18-20,22-24 on IDs 0/1 are separate strikes, not power-decay phases or a stronger finisher.

Rechecked sweetspot-labels.md Remaining clean hits: two zones, bones 14/4, clean 12% at 4-7 and late 9% at 8-37. Source duplicates clean ID 0 in its second row, but bone 4 and independent catalog ID 1 establish the existing second zone; landing is action 72, not sour decay.

Rechecked sweetspot-labels.md Pikachu up-air semi-spike: both IDs/bones 47/50 retain 4%; 3-4 angle 80 sour, 5-6 angle 0 sweet, 7-8 angle 130 sour. Move Overview names middle semi-spike, proving neither max-damage nor earliest-hit selection.
Electric Screw: source distinguishes one 12% airborne hit from 4% landing. Both catalog airborne zones are 12%, angle 361 at 14-26, not a meteor; landing action 74 is a separate strike.

Back-air landing: catalog ID 0 bone 0 has 4% at frame 1 only. Move table says landing 1-2, shortened to 1 by L-cancel. Landing-state/runtime timing differs; do not label this separate hit as sour back air or invent frame 2.

Down-air landing shockwave: source explicitly distinguishes 4% landing from 12% aerial attack. IDs 0/1 retain 4% at frame 1; separate landing collision is not an action-local sourspot of airborne action 69.
Face-up getup: Moveset describes attacking both sides for 6%; catalog has 6% strikes at 13-14 and 18-19 across three root zones. Directional strikes are not early/late decay.
Face-down getup: source gives 6% both sides; three root zones strike at 17-18 and 23-24, always 6%. Keep both strike windows, with no generic first-hit sweet rule.

Standing Catch: source describes a grab, not damaging attack. Two root grab volumes at 6-7 have catalog damage 0. Capture admission/priority are not inferred from damage or ordinary attack sweetspots.
Dash Catch: three root grab volumes at 10-11 have damage 0. Source's grab range discussion does not adjudicate collision/capture priority or convert grabboxes into damaging sweetspots.
Slow ledge attack: source names tail whip at 6%; catalog IDs 0/1 bone 47 are 6%, angle 361 at 54-59. Slow versus fast are separate damage-percent-dependent getup actions, not sweet/sour phases.
Fast ledge cartwheel: source gives 8%; catalog bones 4/43 are 8%, angle 361 at 22-24. Do not rank this action against slow ledge action 256.

QUICK_ATTACK_AIR independently contains 2%, angle 0 at frame 14. Second-warp timing is callback-dependent; neither separate warp power nor generic enum SWORD_DANCE label is sweetspot evidence.
